geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry (RFC 7946, WGS84, positions are [longitude, latitude]; altitude ignored): a Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed. FeatureCollection, LineString and GeometryCollection are refused (`invalid_input`, one place per call). Geometries crossing the antimeridian, with more than 1000 vertices, or above the function's area cap are refused with code `too_large` or `antimeridian`. A geometry outside the U.S. Drought Monitor's coverage (United States, Puerto Rico, U.S. Pacific islands) fails with `outside_coverage`.

200.description:
Share of a geometry in each U.S. Drought Monitor category (None, D0 abnormally dry to D4 exceptional drought) on the current weekly map, with the counties it touches and their county-level shares. Exact when the geometry sits inside one category polygon (`spatial_precision: polygon`); when a category boundary crosses it, shares are estimated from up to 16 interior sample points (`grid_cell`). A Point gets the category at that point.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `categories` | object[] | Every category touching the geometry (plus `None` when part of it is in no category), worst first, with its share of the geometry in percent. Shares sum to 100. |
| `counties` | object[] | Counties intersecting the geometry (NDMC Counties layer) with their county-level categorical shares for the same map date from the USDM county statistics service. |
| `dominant` | string | Category with the largest share. |
| `in_drought` | boolean | True when any part of the geometry is in D1 or worse (D0 is abnormally dry, not drought). |
| `location` | object | Echo of the input geometry as parsed. |
| `map_date` | string | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). |
| `method` | string | `within`: the whole polygon is inside one category polygon (exact). `intersects`: no category touches the polygon, so it is entirely `None` (exact). `point_sample`: a boundary crosses it; shares from interior sample points. `point`: a Point input. |
| `missing` | object[] | Layers that returned nothing for this geometry, with the reason, instead of guessed values. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `release_date` | string | Thursday the map was released; null when the geometry is in no category and the dates come from the county statistics row. |
| `sample_points` | number | Number of interior sample points behind `point_sample` shares; null otherwise. |
| `sources` | object[] |  |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the geometry: `polygon` = exact against the source polygons; `grid_cell` = shares estimated from a grid of interior sample points; `county` = the value is for the county (or counties) containing the geometry; `point` = the value at a single point. |
| `valid_end` | string | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). |
| `valid_start` | string | Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). |
| `worst` | string | Most severe category touching the geometry. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

200.description:
Weekly U.S. Drought Monitor statistics for every county a geometry touches: percent of county area in None/D0-D4 and the Drought Severity and Coverage Index (DSCI), one row per map week, from 2000-01-04 to the current map. `statistics` picks `categorical` (exclusive classes, sum to 100; default) or `traditional` (cumulative: d0 = D0 or worse).
